verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official MCP server that connects external AI assistants to search errors and analyze performance, and MCP access is included even on the solo plan. A documented web API also covers managing and exporting data. However, the evidence never shows agents querying logs or metrics specifically, only errors and performance/trace data, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: documented agent/API querying of logs and metrics, an explicit trace-query API (Trace Explorer is shown only as a UI feature), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent debugging via MCP.
